create.name: Cyndi Lee
create.bio:
Cyndi Lee brings together hatha yoga and Tibetan Buddhist meditation, a pairing she has taught for some three decades. Her root teacher was the Tibetan lama Gelek Rimpoche, and she took ordination as a Buddhist chaplain in 2018 through Roshi Joan Halifax's programme at Upaya Zen Center. Before teaching full time she was a dancer and choreographer in New York's downtown scene, and from 1998 to 2012 she ran OM yoga Center in Manhattan, one of the first studios in the city to hold Buddhist meditation classes alongside postures.

Her books include Yoga Body, Buddha Mind, the memoir May I Be Happy and, more recently, Long Life Yoga, and she writes for Yoga Journal and Lion's Roar. Her teaching is plain-spoken and kind, built around the idea of basic goodness: steady sitting practice, attention to the breath and gaze, and postures approached with curiosity rather than strain. She now lives with her husband in Santa Fe, New Mexico, and teaches mostly online, through the Lifting the Gaze sangha that meets several times a month, a cycle of short meditation retreats across the year, and recorded courses and teacher trainings, as well as an annual in-person retreat.

books.title: Yoga Body, Buddha Mind
books.author: Cyndi Lee
books.description: Her guide to practising postures and meditation as one path, drawing on Tibetan Buddhist teachings. It includes sequences, sitting instruction and reflections on bringing awareness into everyday life.

books.title: May I Be Happy: A Memoir of Love, Yoga, and Changing My Mind
books.author: Cyndi Lee
books.description: A frank memoir about her own long struggle with self-criticism over her body, and how she turned to loving-kindness practice and her Buddhist teachers to soften it.

books.title: Long Life Yoga: Essential Practices for Longevity, Well-Being, and Joy at Any Age
books.author: Cyndi Lee
books.description: A practical book of simple yoga and breathing practices for readers at any stage of life, with short routines that can be fitted into an ordinary day.

courses.title: A Year of Mindful Retreating 2027
courses.description: Six online meditation retreats spread through 2027, each meeting for twenty minutes a day over five days. Book the whole year, a set of three or single retreats.
courses.price: $179 for the year ($115 for 3 retreats, $45 per retreat)

courses.title: Mindfulness Mini-Retreat (December)
courses.description: Five days of short online sittings with Cyndi, each opening with a practical tip on posture, breath or working with obstacles. The last of her 2026 mini-retreats.

courses.title: Lifting the Gaze Sangha
courses.description: An online practice community that meets three times a month for meditation and dharma study with Cyndi. No Buddhist background is needed; membership comes in tiers.
courses.price: $55 per month or $600 per year (Moon level)
